title: FlightPath Prompt Schema
description: Schema for FlightPath prompts. Prompts should be in final-form format with all context variables (e.g., @workspace, #file:path, #selection) and slash commands (e.g., /fix, /explain) included directly in the prompt text.

prompt.description: The final-form prompt text to send to GitHub Copilot. Include all context variables (@workspace, #file:path:line-line, etc.) and slash commands (/fix, /explain, etc.) directly in the text.

model.description: AI model to use for this prompt. Optional - defaults to the model configured in settings (flightpath.copilotCliModel).
